paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is currently 5.88, representing a decrease of 4.85% from the prior close and 6.81% over the last 21 trading sessions. As of August 10, 2026, the stock has been experiencing downward price action.

There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours, with Finanznachrichten reporting that Fermi Inc. has announced a binding lease agreement with TensorWave, intending to grow the partnership to more than 650 megawatts over three phases. The first phase is expected to deliver a complete turnkey data center solution with 222 MW beginning in the second half of 2027.

Fermi Inc. has filed several recent SEC filings, including an 8-K form on July 23, 2026, announcing the appointment of four new officers, and an 8-K form on July 15, 2026, disclosing the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been one Form 4 filing in the feed, but no Form 144 filings.
